title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your school library for improving its service. You are to write about its current problems and possible solutions to these problems. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: I am a sophomore who spends most of my free time studying in our school library. As a frequent user, I am writing to propose several improvements that I believe would enhance its service. Two problems stand out. First, the library closes at nine every evening, which is too early for students who prepare for exams late at night; I suggest extending the opening hours to eleven during examination weeks. Second, the reading area is often noisy because there is no separated quiet zone, so it is hard to concentrate. It would be advisable to set aside a silent room and remind readers to keep their voices down. I believe these changes are simple yet effective, and they would make the library far more welcoming to every student. Thank you very much for considering my suggestions, and I sincerely hope they can be adopted soon.
keyPoints: 身份＋目的一句到位。用‘I am a sophomore who…’自报身份、‘I am writing to propose…’直接点明目的，落实了开头段‘亮身份点目的’的功能，呼应 improving its service，没有多余 铺垫。
First/Second 问题紧跟对策。‘Two problems stand out. First… I suggest…; Second… It would be advisable to…’两组都是问题后立刻接对策，把 current problems and possible solutions to these problems 一一写全，且用了建议式表达保持客气。
价值＋致谢收尾。‘simple yet effective… Thank you very much for considering… I sincerely hope they can be adopted’先讲好处再礼貌致谢，体现建议书的建设性与得体，收束干净。
